title: 别: don't
summary: Lets you tell someone not to do something in a short, friendly way, as in 别走.
explanation:
别 + verb is a short, everyday way to say 'don't': 别走 'Don't go', 别忘了 'Don't forget.' It means the same as 不要 but sounds more casual and spoken.

别 … 了 asks someone to STOP doing something already happening: 别说了 'Stop talking', 别玩手机了 'Stop playing on your phone.'

examples.en: Don't forget to bring your book.
Stop playing on your phone and go to sleep.
It's raining outside; don't go out.

mistakes.why: 别 already means 'don't'; don't add another negative.

exercises.instruction: Ask him to stop (别 … 了).
why: Correct: 别 + verb + 了 = 'stop doing'.
别 goes first, before the verb.

exercises.prompt: Which means 'Don't go out, it's cold'?
why: 别 can't go after the verb.
Don't mix 没 and 别.

exercises.why: 别 goes right before the verb.

exercises.prompt: Which is the same as 不要走?

why: Correct: 别 … 了 = stop doing it.
吗 would make it a question.
